description: The ordinary me...? The most beautiful in the world from today? By the way, who decides that standard?" Kang Hana, an aspiring actress who always failed auditions because of her ordinary appearance despite her outstanding acting skills. Then, one day the global beauty company stated that 'her appearance is her ability' comes at her with a scout offer. And one person is bound to learn Kang Hana's greatest secret...? \*\*Original Webtoon:\*\* \[Naver Webtoon\](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=793944), \[Naver Series\](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=8410481) \*\*Official Translations:\*\* \[S.Chinese\](https://www.dongmanmanhua.cn/METROPOLIS/jinrideweinasi/list?title\_no=2206), \[Japanese\](https://manga.line.me/product/periodic?id=Z0002890)
